title: Conversations, Interviews & Political Analysis
lede: Dr. Çağdaş Duman's media work brings together academic research, political analysis, and conversations with scholars and experts on international relations, Middle Eastern politics, and contemporary global affairs. Through interviews, book talks, and analytical discussions, he explores political developments and complex international issues from an academic perspective.
featuredLede: A selection of featured interviews, discussions, and political analyses.

items.title: Transformative Impact of Political Shocks: Lebanese Hezbollah (2005–2020)
items.description: A discussion of Dr. Çağdaş Duman's research on the transformative effects of political shocks on Lebanese Hezbollah between 2005 and 2020.

items.title: Libya at a Crossroad: Exclusive Talk with Brookings Expert Stephanie Williams
items.description: An exclusive conversation with Stephanie Williams on Libya's political transition, regional dynamics, and the challenges shaping the country's future.

items.title: Maduro Has Fallen, Hezbollah's Global Network Shaken: The Secret Codes of the Maduro Operation
items.description: An analysis of the geopolitical implications of the Maduro operation and its potential impact on Hezbollah's global network and broader international politics.
